newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain 1997 GDP to grow 2.8 percent - BBV.
newsitem.headline: Spain 1997 GDP to grow 2.8 percent - BBV.

text.p: Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) said it was mantaining its forecast for growth of around 2.8 percent in Spain's gross domestic product in 1997.
In a note, it added that the forecast was based on an expected high level of exports, albeit lower than last year's, and a higher domestic demand.

Earlier on Wednesday, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said Spain's 1996 GDP, which rose 2.2 percent during the year and 2.6 percent in the last quarter year-on-year, supported the government forecast for three-percent 1997 growth. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
